observations: A large rectangular form dominates the center, built from concentric nested rectangles in dark, red, and yellow outlines, with a small spiral-like mark at the innermost layer.
White, yellow, and pink zigzag and sawtooth lines run horizontally across multiple zones, dividing the composition into rough stacked bands.
Dense black cross-hatching fills the lower-left and upper-right corners, while patches of teal, red, pink, purple, and muted green fill gaps between the dark scaffolding.
reading: Stacked rectangular frames pull the eye inward toward a tight spiral at the center, suggesting a screen or opening viewed head-on. Sawtooth lines slice across the surface like static, lending a feeling of restless interference. The surrounding field is packed so tightly with overlapping marks that negative space barely survives, which can feel claustrophobic or buzzing with contained pressure.
contextAngle: This is the earliest recorded creation in the owned rawblocks subset. Its title neighbor "nnxyz rawblocks #0000" sits earlier in title order but was recorded much later, showing that title numbering and recorded creation sequence diverge within this family.
